correctness.rationale: Canonical embeddings of 0^m1^m and 1^m0^m into a deletion-minimal common supersequence cover every output position. A simultaneous overlap of first/last m zeros and first/last m ones gives contradictory ordering, forcing exactly 2m copies of one symbol. In the 2m-zero branch splitting around middle two zeros gives exterior counts a=b=j<m and central ones m-j by single-deletion essentiality; choosing j interleavings in each of two arms yields binom(m+j-1,j)^2 and complementary branch doubles it, disjointly. Max length 4m-1 and ratio a(m,j-1)/a(m,j) <=1/4 yields geometric deficit law and asymptotics. Independent brute enumerated ALL binary strings of lengths 2m through 4m inclusive for m=1..4 and checked both subsequence requirements and deletion minimality; exact predicted histograms all matched.
